summary: RETEST-ONLY verification of 5 previously-reported bug fixes on BUG-009 + CR-042 + CR-043. All 5 fixes VERIFIED PASS. Backend pytest regression: 38/38 PASS. Frontend Playwright: C1/M1/L1/L2/L3 all verified end-to-end with JWT-injected sessions. No new bugs discovered.

C1_details_button_route.evidence: Clicked Details on first row of /campaign-history — URL became `/message-status?campaign_id=dfa1fed9-2ee8-4542-a160-fefe3f91853f&run_id=83b6367e-5625-4015-8781-f17aeb4229b6`. Green emerald 'Filtered to run' banner visible with correct run_id text. Clear-run-filter button visible. Code at CampaignHistoryPage.jsx L211 confirmed `/message-status?...`.

C1_regression_view_messages.note: Playwright found 0 elements matching [data-testid^='view-messages-btn-'] on /campaigns. The CR-026 path uses different testid — code inspection confirms CampaignsPage.jsx L310 & L345 still use `/message-status?campaign_id=X`. No regression risk since main agent only changed CampaignHistoryPage.jsx L206.

M1_per_row_export_wrappers.evidence: 13 wrappers, 13 UNIQUE data-history-export-wrapper attribute values (one per run.id). Opening row 0 dropdown then clicking row 1 Export button: only row 1 dropdown remains open (2 menu items visible → 0 after switch → 2 for the new one). Outside-click on blank area at (50,50) closes the dropdown cleanly.

M1_export_selection_regression.note: Export button trigger + CSV/XLSX menu items still render and click-through logic in useEffect only closes dropdowns whose wrapper attribute != openExportRunId. No download initiated in test to avoid file writes, but backend export endpoints previously 27/27 PASS.

L1_messages_export_wrapper_id_dedup.evidence: On /message-status: exactly 1 element with id='messages-export-wrapper', 0 with id='messages-export-wrapper-embedded' (non-embedded mode). Export dropdown opens on click, closes on outside click (verified CSV item transitions visible→not-visible after clicking at page (50,50)).

L2_chip_label_spacing.evidence: DOM inspection: chip inner HTML is `+Lunch(6)`. Computed style on tag-name span: margin-left = 4px. Parent button computed style: gap = 4px. Visual screenshot confirms chips render as `+ Lunch (6)`, `+ Dinner (5)`, `+ Breakfast (2)`, `+ Churn (0)` with clear space between `+` prefix and tag name. NOTE: text_content() returns `+Lunch(6)` because DOM text nodes are concatenated without CSS margins — this is EXPECTED for CSS-margin-based spacing and does NOT indicate a defect. The spec `+ Lunch (5)` is satisfied visually.

L3_no_leaked_test_tags.evidence: GET /api/customers/tags returned exactly ['Breakfast','Churn','Dinner','Lunch'] (alphabetical, 4 items) after DB cleanup. GET /api/customers/tags?with_counts=true returned 4 entries (Lunch:6, Dinner:5, Breakfast:2, Churn:0). /customers page renders exactly 4 individual chips: tag-chip-Lunch, tag-chip-Dinner, tag-chip-Breakfast, tag-chip-Churn. No TESTTAG_* or TEST_* chips visible. IMPORTANT: running the backend pytest suite re-leaked a TESTTAG_* entry (as documented in iteration_2). Cleanup was applied via db.users.update_one to restore ['Breakfast','Lunch','Dinner','Churn'] before frontend verification. This is not a NEW bug — it is the same known catalog-retention behaviour flagged as LOW in iteration_2.
L3_no_leaked_test_tags.warning: Any future run of /app/backend/tests/test_bug009_cr042_cr043.py will re-leak a TESTTAG_* entry into available_tags. Recommend main agent adds a pytest fixture teardown that pulls the created TESTTAG from available_tags.

BUG_009_end_to_end.evidence: Full flow: /campaign-history → click Details → land on /message-status?campaign_id=X&run_id=Y → green banner visible with `Filtered to run: 83b6367e...` → click Clear-run-filter → URL becomes /message-status?campaign_id=X (run_id removed) → green banner disappears. Blue CR-026 campaign banner behavior not blocked.

CR_042_export_regression.note: Backend pytest test_bug009_cr042_cr043.py — 27/27 PASS including CSV+XLSX export endpoints. Frontend UI verified: MessageStatusPage Export button opens dropdown with CSV/XLSX items, closes on outside click. CampaignHistoryPage per-row Export button opens/closes correctly.

CR_043_chip_and_multiselect_regression.note: Chip strip renders 4 chips correctly. Chip click applies filter (verified click on Lunch chip). Multi-select autosave popover code path (CustomersPage.jsx L1692) unchanged — no code delta by main agent for CR-043-B.

action_items: OPTIONAL LOW: Add pytest teardown in test_bug009_cr042_cr043.py::TestTagRowEndpoints to pull the created TESTTAG_* from available_tags after each test run. Currently every regression run leaks one zero-count TESTTAG_* into the tenant catalog (harmless, but pollutes the chip strip).
critical_code_review_comments: All 5 code changes for iteration 3 are minimum-diff and semantically correct. No new files or functions added.
CampaignHistoryPage.jsx L211 fix (`/messages` → `/message-status`) — matches CampaignsPage.jsx L310/L345 pattern. Route consistency restored.
CampaignHistoryPage.jsx L46-47 outside-click handler compares wrapper.getAttribute against openExportRunId — correct semantics for per-row scope.
CampaignHistoryPage.jsx L236 wrapper uses run.id as unique attribute value — 13/13 unique verified.
MessageStatusPage.jsx L192-193 outside-click check for both #messages-export-wrapper AND #messages-export-wrapper-embedded — future-safe for both modes.

CustomersPage.jsx L966 `{tag}` — CSS-margin-based spacing (Tailwind ml-1 = 0.25rem = 4px). Combined with existing `gap-1` on parent button, chips render with ~8px visual space between prefix and tag. This is aesthetically equivalent to the spec `+ Lunch (5)`. If STRICT text-content spacing is required (e.g. for accessibility/screen-readers), consider adding a literal space instead of/in addition to the margin.

STALE FROM iteration_2 (still applicable, NOT part of this retest): backend/routers/whatsapp.py L1327 filename convention, whatsapp.py L1319 5000-row cap, customers.py L1080-1087 $or clobbering risk, whatsapp.py file size >1800 lines. Main agent may address in a separate ticket.
